name: codebase-wiki
description: Karpathy-style docs/index.md wiki for any codebase — progressive disclosure for LLM agents.

interface.shortDescription: Build a progressive-disclosure wiki for a codebase.
interface.longDescription: Codebase Wiki builds and maintains a docs/index.md wiki so an agent can enter a codebase through progressive disclosure instead of reading everything.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codebase Wiki to initialise or audit this repository's documentation index.
